negative_reviews.author: Tanjila Akthar
negative_reviews.text: Ok food. Waiting time really long. But amazing service by Charlotte W

negative_reviews.author: Jasmine Patel
negative_reviews.text: My partner and I were really excited to try this new ramen spot out, however we were disappointed with our experience. When ordering drinks, we were told they hadn't got any coke in stock and it just got worse from there really.. the ramen lacked flavour, the broth tasted powdery, the boiled egg was stone cold and the noodles were stiff. The whole dish tasted cheap - nothing authentic about it and nothing compared to the real thing in Japan. Sorry, I would not recommend this place!
